title: Chat thread
description: A generic messaging conversation that builds message by message, with a typing indicator before each incoming message; older messages move up as new ones arrive.

contact.description: Name in the header (first letter becomes the avatar).

messages.description: [{from: me|them, text, at}] with at in scene-local seconds, in order.

typing.description: Seconds the typing indicator shows before an incoming message; 0 for none.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: readcheck: each message readable before the next pushes it up
generic look, no imitation of a specific app
